errors.not_registered: this machine is not a runner yet ({path} does not exist): run `thulu runner register`
errors.bad_ref: the daemon sent a branch git does not accept: {ref}
errors.project_unmapped: project {project} ({id}) has no folder on this runner: run `thulu runner add-project {id} <dir>`
errors.missing_tools: this machine is missing what a run needs: {tools}
errors.wrong_repo: the folder {path} mapped to project {project} is another repository: its origin is {origin}, the project is {want}. Fix the mapping with `thulu runner add-project`.
errors.project_file: copy {file} from the checkout: only relative paths inside it
errors.left_branch: the agent left project {project} on {head} instead of {branch}: nothing was committed or pushed for it

log.no_projects: no projects mapped yet: add one with `thulu runner add-project <project-id> <dir>`
log.started: runner {name} taking runs from {daemon} ({projects} projects, {concurrency} at a time)
log.claim_failed: ask the daemon for a run: {err}
log.swept: left over from a previous runner process: run {job} stopped and its folder removed
log.fetch_failed: fetch {branch} in {repo}; the task branch starts from what the checkout already has
log.upstream_failed: make {branch} track origin in {repo}; a plain git push from the agent will ask for an upstream
log.ship_failed: send {bytes} bytes of run {job}'s log; the daemon's copy has a gap there
log.pid_file_failed: write the run's pid file in {path}; if this runner dies, the next start cannot stop the run
log.group_check_failed: check whether process group {pid} is still running
log.checkout_state_failed: read the state of the checkout {path}

warnings.checkout_changed: The checkout at {path} changed while the agent ran (its HEAD or its files). If nobody worked in it, check what the agent did there.
